title: Level
premise: Maria spent a weekend hanging her own kitchen cabinets. They look almost right: one sags, the doors don't line up, and the level never settles. She calls Daniel, an installer who works in silence and checks everything twice. With her helping, he resets every cabinet to a laser line, anchors it to the studs, shims it square, and dials each hinge until every gap matches. The film ends on one soft-closing door.
logline: A homeowner whose DIY cabinets are almost right learns, alongside a meticulous installer, what right actually looks like.

timeline: Maria buys white shaker cabinets for her 1990s kitchen.
She hangs the uppers herself over a weekend.
Monday morning the doors already sag out of line.
Tuesday she books a professional installer; the film is that visit.
era_rules: Real tools only: cross-line laser level, cordless drill, spirit level, wood shims, F-clamps, screwdriver.
No brand logos visible on any tool or cabinet.

factions.name: DIY homeowners
factions.goal: save money and do it themselves
factions.power_over: they decide whether a pro is worth paying for

factions.name: Professional installers
factions.goal: be trusted with the whole kitchen
factions.power_over: skill and patience a weekend can't buy

world_rules: Every quality claim is shown physically: a laser line, a bubble, a measured gap.
No price, time or guarantee claims are spoken or shown.
The installer never mocks the homeowner's attempt; he includes her in the work.

locations.name: Maria's kitchen
visual_motifs: white shaker uppers with brushed-brass bar pulls

characters.name: Daniel Reyes

characters.want: To leave every kitchen better than the drawings.
characters.vocal_cadence: Low, warm, few words; finishes sentences with a small nod.
behavioral_ticks: sights down every edge with one eye closed
taps a cabinet twice after it's fastened
keeps a pencil behind his ear

characters.flaw: Hates admitting a job beat her.
characters.want: A kitchen she doesn't have to apologize for.
characters.vocal_cadence: Quick, wry, self-deprecating; laughs at her own mistakes.
behavioral_ticks: tucks hair behind her ear when thinking
